name: development-claude-plugin
description: Plugin family for projects that ARE Claude Code plugins. Ships a test harness (/development-claude-plugin:test) and a maintenance dispatcher (a topic plugin: composes alongside the language plugin via /development:maintenance). v1 validator: plugin.json <-> marketplace.json version sync, fixed by the claude-plugin-version-sync agent. Further validators (skill-structure, orphaned references, directory structure) follow.
